mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 7.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, correlating with improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 55% of periods when UNRATE < 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% quarterly) and housing starts acceleration (HOUST > 0.3% monthly) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5% and HOUST growth rate > 0.3%
failure_condition: The joint GDPC1/HOUST signal fails to produce positive returns in > 50% of 60-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated CPIAUCSL growth (> 3% annualized) in high inflation regimes triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL growth > 3%).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 97.0) reflects expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive returns in > 55% of 5-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals robust job creation, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS growth > 0.3%) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL growth < 2.5%) indicates sustainable consumer demand without inflationary pressure, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth rate > 0.3% and CPIAUCSL growth rate < 2.5%
failure_condition: The joint RSAFS/CPIAUCSL signal fails to yield positive returns in > 50% of 60-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.5% quarterly) signals economic peak, preceding negative equity returns due to impending policy tightening over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 1.5%.
